name: Surface Rendering with Texture Atlas Export
aliases: surface texture export from volume rendering
definition: An algorithm that exports a textured 3D surface mesh directly from volume rendering by baking the volume rendering appearance (WW/WL, CLUT, projection) onto the surface mesh, allowing export as OBJ or VRML with retained color maps.
summary: Surface Rendering with Texture Atlas Export bakes volume rendering appearance onto a pre-existing surface mesh, decoupling geometry from texturing to ensure the exported OBJ or VRML matches the volume render exactly.
